## Accordion

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/accordion.html

Accordion Stable Stacked sections that expand in place. Built on details/summary: open state, keyboard and screen reader support come from the browser. Usage <div class="accordion-group"> <details class="accordion"> <summary>What is the default gutter?</summary> <div class="accordion-body">5px on the container, 5px on each block.</div> </details> <details class="accordion"> <summary>Can I change it?</summary> <div class="accordion-body">Yes — padding on .container and .container-block is yours.</div> </details> </div> Live demo What is the default gutter? 5px on the container, 5px on each block. Can I change it? Yes — the padding on .container and .container-block is yours to override. Why details and not divs? Open state, keyboard support and the screen reader announcement are free. Rebuilding them is the classic source of bugs. Inside .accordion-group, opening one closes the others (gals.js, one delegated listener). Notes Content inside a closed <details> is not searchable in the browser find bar — never hide a fact there. Without .accordion-group every section opens independently — the wrapper is opt-in.

## Alert

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/alert.html

Alert Stable A message in the flow of the page, in four semantic colours from the tokens. Usage <p class="alert alert-ok" role="status">Saved.</p> <p class="alert alert-warn" role="status">The draft is unsaved.</p> <p class="alert alert-error" role="alert"> Could not save — check your connection and retry. </p> Live demo Heads up: this is alert-info, the accent colour. Saved. The draft is unsaved. Could not save — check your connection and retry. Notes role="alert" interrupts the screen reader. Four of those on one page is noise, and the one that matters gets lost. Ordinary, user-initiated feedback takes role="status", which waits for a pause. The colour comes from the --ok, --warn, --err and --accent tokens.

## Appearance animation

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/appearance-animation.html

Appearance animation Stable Элементы появляются при попадании в вьюпорт через IntersectionObserver. Usage const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach((e) => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('appeared'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }); }, { threshold: 0.15 }); document.querySelectorAll('.appear').forEach((el) => io.observe(el)); Live demo .appear { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); transition: opacity .5s ease, transform .5s ease; padding: 16px; margin: 8px 0; background: #f0ecf7; border-radius: 8px; font: 14px system-ui; color:#333; } .appear.appeared { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } .appear-demo { max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; } Блок 1 Блок 2 Блок 3 Блок 4 Блок 5 Блок 6 Replay Прокрутите демо-блок или нажмите Replay. Notes unobserve после первого появления — экономит ресурсы. root можно указать, чтобы считать «вьюпорт» не окна, а контейнера. Для prefers-reduced-motion отключайте анимацию — это несложно и важно.

## Basket counter

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/basket-counter.html

Basket counter Stable Счётчик на кнопке корзины: числовой badge, кнопка сброса и модальное подтверждение при попытке сбросить пустую корзину. Usage <button class="btn btn-primary" id="basket" type="button"> Basket <span class="badge">0</span> </button> <button class="btn" id="reset" type="button">Reset</button> <dialog id="confirm" class="modal"> <form method="dialog"> <p>Basket is already empty.</p> <button class="btn" value="ok">OK</button> </form> </dialog> Live demo .bk-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; background: #d1495b; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 12px/1 system-ui; margin-left: 8px; } Basket 0 Reset Basket is empty — нечего сбрасывать. OK Кнопка Basket наращивает счётчик. Reset при нуле показывает модалку. Notes Bootstrap-классы badge, bg-danger, position-absolute заменены на свои — 8 строк CSS. Модалка — нативный <dialog>, без библиотек. Счётчик в aria-live="polite", если число обновляется без прямого действия пользователя.

## Battery indicator

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/battery-indicator.html

Battery indicator Stable Индикатор заряда батареи на Battery Status API: уровень, статус зарядки и анимация заполнения. Usage <div class="battery"> <div class="battery-level"></div> <p class="battery-digit">—</p> <div class="battery-cap"></div> </div> const level = document.querySelector('.battery-level'); const digit = document.querySelector('.battery-digit'); if (!navigator.getBattery) { digit.textContent = 'N/A'; // Firefox и Safari — API нет } else { navigator.getBattery().then((battery) => { const render = () => { digit.textContent = Math.round(battery.level * 100) + '%'; level.style.width = battery.level * 100 + '%'; level.classList.toggle('charging', battery.charging); }; render(); battery.addEventListener('chargingchange', render); battery.addEventListener('levelchange', render); }); } Live demo .demo-battery { position: relative; width: 100px; height: 50px; border: 1px solid #555; border-radius: 3px; margin: 1em auto; } .demo-battery-level { position: absolute; top: 1px; left: 1px; height: 46px; width: 0; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #2a9d4a 40%, #7fd67f); transition: width .3s; } .demo-battery-anim { animation: demo-battery-fill 4s linear infinite; } @keyframes demo-battery-fill { 0% { width: 0; } 100% { width: 98px; } } .demo-battery-digit { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0; font: 700 14px/1 system-ui; z-index: 1; } .demo-battery-cap { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 100px; width: 7px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid #555; border-left-color: #fff; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: #888; } .demo-battery-status { text-align: center; color: #555; font-size: 14px; } — Read battery Battery Status API работает только в Chromium и по https/localhost. Notes В исходном примере были опечатки в именах событий: charginchange, chargintimechange, dischargintimechange — исправлены на chargingchange, chargingtimechange, dischargingtimechange. Ветки if (chargingTime == Infinity) в оригинале выводили одинаковый текст — здесь логика упрощена до одного render(). API недоступен в Firefox и Safari — всегда показывайте заглушку, как в демо.

## Gradient border

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/border-gradient.html

Gradient border Stable Градиентная рамка у блока: два фона, padding-box и border-box, поверх прозрачной границы. Usage .gradient-border { --bg: lightcoral; --border-gradient: linear-gradient(to right, #bb2577, #3782ef); background: linear-gradient(var(--bg), var(--bg)) padding-box, var(--border-gradient) border-box; border: 10px solid transparent; border-radius: 15px; } Live demo .gb-demo { --bg: lightcoral; --border-gradient: linear-gradient(to right, #bb2577, #3782ef); width: 140px; height: 140px; margin: 20px auto; background: linear-gradient(var(--bg), var(--bg)) padding-box, var(--border-gradient) border-box; border: 10px solid transparent; border-radius: 18px; } Notes padding-box рисует фон только внутри, border-box — во всей рамке. Прозрачная граница нужна, чтобы сквозь неё был виден второй фон. Работает во всех современных браузерах. Для IE (не нужен) — border-image.

## Bounce animation

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/bounce.html

Bounce animation Stable Отскок элемента при наведении. Раньше был jQuery — теперь чистый CSS и classList. Usage <h1 class="bounce-title" onmouseover="this.classList.add('bounce')">Bounce animation</h1> <div class="bounce-box" onmouseover="this.classList.add('bounce')"></div> Live demo @keyframes bounce-y { 20%, 50%, 80%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 40% { transform: translateY(-30px); } 70% { transform: translateY(-15px); } 90% { transform: translateY(-4px); } } .bounce { animation: bounce-y 1s linear; } .bounce-demo-box { width: 200px; height: 120px; background: yellowgreen; margin: 30px auto 0; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; } .bounce-demo-title { text-align: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px; user-select: none; margin: 0 0 10px; } Bounce animation Наведите курсор на заголовок и на блок. Notes jQuery больше не нужен: classList.add делает то же самое. Класс снимается через animationend, если нужно повторять эффект. Под prefers-reduced-motion анимацию лучше отключить.

## Bounce cube

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/bounce-cube.html

Bounce cube Stable Куб прыгает и приседает, меняя форму в точке удара. Только @keyframes, без JS. Usage <div class="stage"> <div class="cube"></div> </div> @keyframes bounce-cube { 0% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); } 10% { transform: scale(1.1, .9) translateY(0); } 30% { transform: scale(.9, 1.1) translateY(-100px); } 50% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); } 100% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); } } Live demo @keyframes bounce-cube { 0% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); } 10% { transform: scale(1.1, .9) translateY(0); } 30% { transform: scale(.9, 1.1) translateY(-100px); } 50% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); } 100% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); } } .cube-stage { height: 220px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; border-bottom: 3px solid #444; padding-bottom: 0; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 360px; } .cube { width: 100px; height: 100px; background: #F44336; margin: 0 auto; transform-origin: bottom; animation: bounce-cube 2s ease infinite; } Notes transform-origin: bottom — точка сжатия внизу, поэтому куб не смещается по горизонтали. Один transform на кадр: scale и translateY вместе, без left/top. Бесконечная анимация на странице — только одна. Это правило здоровья вёрстки.

## Box size indicator

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/box-size-indicator.html

Box size indicator Stable Стрелки-индикаторы следуют за курсором и показывают ширину блока под ним — наглядный урок про offsetWidth. Usage <div class="stage"> <span class="arrows"></span> <div class="box"></div> <div class="box"></div> <div class="box"></div> </div> const arrows = document.querySelector('.arrows'); const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.box'); boxes.forEach((box) => { box.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => { const el = e.currentTarget; arrows.style.top = el.offsetTop + 'px'; arrows.style.left = el.offsetLeft + 'px'; arrows.style.width = el.offsetWidth + 'px'; arrows.textContent = el.offsetWidth + 'px'; }); }); Live demo .demo-ind-stage { position: relative; width: 300px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 20px; background: #333; border-radius: 7px; } .demo-ind-arrows { position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 0; height: 50px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: #fff; font: 13px system-ui; transition: top .3s, left .3s, width .3s; pointer-events: none; padding: 0 4px; box-sizing: border-box; } .demo-ind-arrows::before, .demo-ind-arrows::after { content: ''; width: 15px; height: 15px; flex: none; border-top: 2px solid #30a3ff; border-right: 2px solid #30a3ff; } .demo-ind-arrows::before { transform: rotate(-135deg); } .demo-ind-arrows::after { transform: rotate(45deg); } .demo-ind-box { position: relative; width: 100px; height: 50px; border: 1px solid #fff; } /* :nth-of-type считает только div, span со стрелками не в счёт. */ .demo-ind-box:nth-of-type(2) { width: 150px; } .demo-ind-box:nth-of-type(3) { width: 250px; } .demo-ind-line { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; pointer-events: none; } .demo-ind-line::before, .demo-ind-line::after { content: ''; background: #30a3ff; width: calc(40% - 11px); height: 1px; } Attach indicator Нажмите «Attach indicator», затем водите курсором по рамкам. Notes В исходнике слушатель вешался на mousemove каждого блока и читал e.target — при вложенной линии target «промахивался». Здесь используется e.currentTarget. Стрелки из исходника поворачивались трансформами с translate — в демо заменены на простые rotate(±45/−135deg), без сдвига. Линия создаётся один раз и перекладывается appendChild — не плодите DOM-узлы на каждый mousemove. В CSS-версии :nth-of-type(3) и (4) не работали, потому что span со стрелками сдвигает нумерацию. Исправлено на :nth-of-type(2) и (3) — стрелки также получают left для центрирования над блоком.

## Brand

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/brand.html

Brand Partial The name, the mark, and where the colours of this site stop being the framework. Name GALS is set in the display face on the wordmark and spelled uppercase everywhere. The repository, the folder and the download keep the lowercase gals spelling. Colours The framework ships seven colour tokens — --accent, --ink, --paper, --ok, --warn, --err and --line. Components use them as their base palette; a few surface and control shades are still concrete values, so a complete dark theme is not a one-block override yet. The yellow, black and white below are this page’s own stylesheet, layered on top of the same tokens rather than replacing them. /* gals.css — the framework tokens */ --accent: #8512d1; /* brand, primary, focus */ --ink: #222222; /* text */ --paper: #ffffff; /* ground */ /* style.css — documentation site only */ --primary: #e3e027; --main: #000; --secondary: #fff; --tertiary: #827F03; Using the mark Clear space equal to the height of the mark on every side. The wordmark alone below 24px of height; the mark carries nothing legible at that size. Black on light ground, white on dark. No other pairing.

## Breakpoints

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/breakpoints.html

Breakpoints Stable Six fixed breakpoints, one prefix each. The prefix sits between pt- and the column number, and it is the only place where GALS talks about screen size. Prefixes PrefixMedia queryClasses xlmin-width: 1440pxpt-xl1 … pt-xl12 lmax-width: 1439.98pxpt-l1 … pt-l12 mmax-width: 1025pxpt-m1 … pt-m12 smax-width: 770pxpt-s1 … pt-s12 xsmax-width: 425pxpt-xs1 … pt-xs12 xxsmax-width: 375pxpt-xxs1 … pt-xxs12 How they stack Prefixes are independent, not mobile-first. Each one lives inside a single media query, so a class does nothing outside its own range and never inherits from a smaller one. Declare every range you care about: <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-6 pt-m12">half on desktop, full below 1025px</div> </div> Boundary at 1440px The l block ends at 1439.98px and xl starts at 1440px, so exactly one of them matches at any viewport width. The base pt-* width still applies everywhere; prefixed classes override it. Changing a breakpoint Breakpoints are written as literal media queries in gals/gals.css, one block per prefix — there is no variable to override yet. Edit the six @media blocks and rebuild, or keep the shipped file and write your own range around the same column widths.

## Buttons

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/buttons.html

Buttons Stable Two weights and one rule about which element to use. Usage <button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button> <button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save draft</button> <a class="btn" href="/docs">Read the docs</a> <button class="btn" type="button" disabled>Unavailable</button> Live demo Cancel Save draft Read the docs Unavailable Notes Label the action, never the mechanic: “Save draft”, not “Click here”. Keep 44px of hit height on touch — widen with padding, not by scaling the label. A disabled button must be genuinely unreachable, not greyed out and silent. Native escape hatches ComponentNative escape hatch Accordion<details> Dropdownpopover attribute Modal<dialog> Progress<progress> Tabsradios + :checked

## Canvas chart

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/canvas-chart.html

Canvas chart Stable График на голом <canvas>: сетка, линия, точки. Всё считается вручную. Usage <canvas id="chart" width="600" height="300"></canvas> <button class="btn" onclick="drawLineChart('chart', [[0,0],[2,3],[4,2],…])"> Draw </button> Live demo Draw the chart Notes Для многих точек рисуйте в requestAnimationFrame: canvas не перерисовывает себя сам. Retina: держите canvas.width вдвое больше CSS-ширины. Для интерактива (тултипы, зум) canvas придётся дополнять обработчиками попадания.

## Canvas for your projects

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/canvas-for-your-projects.html

Canvas for your projects Stable A canvas is a bitmap you draw on. Right tool for many pixels, wrong tool for anything a user reads. The framework has no canvas API — this page is the guidance that keeps you out of trouble. When to use it NeedUse a chart with fifty pointscanvas a chart with a selectable legendSVG or plain HTML text a user can read, select or translateHTML — never canvas Crisp, not blurry The one thing that separates a crisp chart from a blurry one is scaling by device pixel ratio. Set the attribute size, then draw in CSS units. const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1; canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth * dpr; canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight * dpr; ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); // now draw in CSS pixels Accessibility A canvas is opaque to assistive technology: role="img" and an aria-label that states the trend, with the numbers in a table nearby. Redraw on resize, not on scroll, and stop the loop when the canvas leaves the viewport.

## Card

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/card.html

Card Stable Media, body and actions for one item of content, in a box that stretches with its column. Usage <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-4 pt-m6 pt-xs12"> <article class="card"> <h3 class="card-title">Title</h3> <p class="card-body">Supporting copy.</p> <div class="card-footer"><a class="btn" href="#">Open</a></div> </article> </div> </div> Live demo Grid Twelve columns, six breakpoints, one constant. Open Runtime One file, no exports, no dependencies. Open Docs Every page carries a status badge, and the badge is honest. Open .card-footer sits at the bottom of every card, whatever the body length. Notes Do not wrap the whole card in a link if it contains links — nested targets are ambiguous to a keyboard. The title is a heading in document order whatever the design says about its size. Equal heights are the grid, not the card: the container stretches its blocks.

## Card 3D

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/card-3d.html

Card 3D Stable Три карточки, сложенные в стопку под углом, разворачиваются в ряд при наведении на контейнер. Usage <div class="deck"> <div class="deck-card" style="--i:-1"> <svg><!-- brush icon --></svg> Design </div> <div class="deck-card" style="--i:0"> <svg><!-- code icon --></svg> Code </div> <div class="deck-card" style="--i:1"> <svg><!-- rocket icon --></svg> Launch </div> </div> Live demo .deck { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 640px; height: 240px; margin: 0 auto; background: #fafafa; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .deck-card { position: absolute; top: calc(50% - 90px); left: 50%; width: 170px; height: 170px; background: #333; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(calc(24px * var(--i))) rotate(35deg) skew(-15deg, -8deg) scale(.7); box-shadow: 20px 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2); z-index: calc(-1 * var(--i)); transition: transform .5s ease, opacity .5s ease; border-radius: 10px; font: 600 15px/1 "Montserrat", sans-serif; } .deck-card svg { fill: #18ffaf; width: 40px; height: 40px; } .deck-card:nth-child(2) { opacity: .8; } .deck-card:nth-child(3) { opacity: .6; } .deck:hover .deck-card { transform: translateX(calc(-50% + 180px * var(--i))) translateY(0) rotate(0) skew(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; } @media (max-width: 500px) { .deck:hover .deck-card { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(calc(80px * var(--i))) rotate(0) skew(0) scale(.7); } } Design Code Launch Наведите на контейнер: карточки разворачиваются в ряд. Notes Позиция считается от CSS-переменной --i: один блок правил на все три карточки. z-index: calc(-1 * var(--i)) — карточки уходят под соседей в правильном порядке. На узком экране раскладка переключается в колонку — там же пригодится @media.

## Cards from array

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/cards-from-array.html

Cards from array Stable Генерация карточек из массива данных через map() и шаблонные строки. Usage const people = [ { id: 1, name: 'Tommy', age: 23, img: '...' }, { id: 2, name: 'John', age: 26, img: '...' }, ]; const card = (p) => ` <div class="card"> <img src="${p.img}" alt=""> <h3>${p.name}</h3> <p>age: ${p.age}</p> </div> `; app.innerHTML = people.map(card).join(''); Live demo .cards-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; padding: 10px; min-height: 100px; } .card-item { background: linear-gradient(#ccffee, #fff); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; text-align: center; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transition: transform .25s; } .card-item:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .card-item img { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; margin: 0 auto 8px; display: block; } .card-item h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 15px; color: #2a9d4a; } .card-item p { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #777; } Render cards Нажмите «Render cards». Notes Одна map и join() вместо ручного innerHTML +=: чище и быстрее. Аватары — SVG в data-URL, чтобы демо не тянуло внешние картинки. Для больших списков шаблонные строки заменяются на <template> и клонирование — тогда HTML не парсится на каждый элемент.

## Carousel

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/carousel.html

Carousel Stable A slide ring with native touch physics and no JavaScript: scroll snap does the whole job. Usage <div class="carousel"> <div class="carousel-slide"><img src="1.svg" alt=""></div> <div class="carousel-slide"><img src="2.svg" alt=""></div> <div class="carousel-slide"><img src="3.svg" alt=""></div> </div> Live demo Slide 1 Slide 2 Slide 3 Drag, swipe or scroll — the track snaps each slide to the centre. Notes If the content matters it does not belong here — slide two and beyond are almost never seen. Slides are 80% of the track; override flex-basis for wider or full-bleed slides. Autoplay, if you must add it yourself, must pause on hover, on focus and under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Chart.js integration

Usage <table id="sales" class="table table-bordered">…</table> <canvas id="mixed" width="600" height="300"></canvas> <button class="btn" onclick="drawChartJs('mixed', 'sales')">Render chart</button> Live demo MonthLine ALine BBars Jan652847 Feb594838 Mar804029 Render chart Notes Chart.js подключается лениво: скрипт с CDN появляется только когда пользователь нажал «Render». ## Charts

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/charts.html

Charts Planned Charting is out of scope for a grid toolkit, and GALS does not pretend otherwise. What it can do is give charts a stable box to live in. Status Not in the current build No chart primitives, no canvas helpers, no colour scales. The demo in demo/ draws an SVG by hand and is not part of the framework. Workaround today Give the chart a column, let the library read the container, and let the grid handle the rest: <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-8"> <svg viewBox="0 0 380 120" preserveAspectRatio="none">…</svg> </div> <div class="container-block pt-4">legend</div> </div> legend Proposed API Nothing is proposed. A chart layer would mean a JavaScript API, and the framework has exactly one job: laying boxes out.

## Checkbox & Radio

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/checkbox-radio.html

Checkbox & Radio Stable Real inputs with a drawn box. The label is the click target, so the hit area is never the 13px square the browser gives you. Usage Keep the input in the DOM and visually hide it — display: none would remove it from the accessibility tree. The box is a sibling span driven from :checked, and the focus ring survives on the box because the selector is :focus-visible + .checkbox-box. <label class="checkbox"> <input type="checkbox" name="terms"> <span class="checkbox-box" aria-hidden="true"></span> <span>I agree to the terms</span> </label> <label class="radio"> <input type="radio" name="plan" value="monthly"> <span class="radio-box" aria-hidden="true"></span> <span>Monthly</span> </label> <label class="switch"> <input type="checkbox" name="autoplay" role="switch"> <span class="switch-box" aria-hidden="true"></span> <span>Autoplay</span> </label> I agree to the terms Also the newsletter Monthly Yearly Autoplay Click the text, not the box: the whole label is the target. Tab to see the ring on the box. Notes ClassForNotes .checkboxone value per controlbox drawn from :checked .radioone of a short listsame pattern, round box .switcha setting applied at onceonly if pressing it needs no submit .field-groupfieldset resetkeeps legend as the accessible name

## Responsive font-size with clamp()

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/clamp-font.html

Responsive font-size with clamp() Stable Резиновая типографика одной строкой: clamp(min, preferred, max) вместо лесенки медиазапросов. Usage <main> <h2>Responsive font-size</h2> <p>Example: use the <code>clamp()</code> function to make the size fluid.</p> </main> <style> main { max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; } h2 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 3rem); text-align: center; color: #007bff; } p { font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); line-height: 1.6; color: #333; } </style> Live demo .demo-clamp { max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; } .demo-clamp h2 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 3rem); text-align: center; color: #007bff; margin: .3em 0; } .demo-clamp p { font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); line-height: 1.6; color: #333; } Responsive font-size Example: use the clamp() function to make the size fluid. Resize the window — the heading scales between 1.5rem and 3rem without a single media query. Сожмите окно браузера: заголовок плавно уменьшится до 1.5rem. Notes В исходнике были опечатки: «Responsiv», «Example yse», «make size» — исправлены. Средний аргумент в vw — это и есть «резина»; крайние значения страхуют от слишком мелкого и слишком крупного текста. GALS делает то же самое токенами --fs-* — но для разового заголовка clamp() проще.

## Classes

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/classes.html

Classes Stable The complete set of helpers in gals.css. Everything the framework adds beyond the grid is a one-property class, listed here in full. Every helper ClassWhat it sets .space-between / -around / -centerjustify-content on a .container .align-center / -flexEnd / -flexStartalign-items on a .container .alignSelf-center / -start / -baseline / -endalign-self on one column .content-between / -center / -arounda flex row that is not a grid container .container-flexbare display: flex .container-fluid / .flex-grow1 / .flex-grow2flex-grow 1 or 2 .text-centertext-align .padding-lghorizontal clamp(12px, 6vw, 80px) .border / .borderRed / -Green / -Blueoutline, for debugging a layout .pt-xl-d_n … .pt-xxs-d_ndisplay: none inside one breakpoint Hiding a column The -d_n family is the only responsive utility besides the widths, and it is scoped ' to a single breakpoint like the rest. Hiding a column is cheaper than rebuilding it. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-8">always visible</div> <div class="container-block pt-4 pt-s-d_n">gone below 770px</div> </div> pt-8 pt-s-d_n Narrow the window past 770px and the second cell disappears. Debugging a row The .border* classes use outline, not border, so adding one ' cannot change a width and make the bug you are chasing worse. pt-4 pt-4 The red outline is the container padding, the green ones are the blocks. Where to stop Three or more helpers doing one job is a component — give it a name. And never override a component ' with a utility; fix the component or add a modifier to it. Not shipped There is no spacing scale, no .d-flex, no .visually-hidden. The screen reader helper in use on this site comes from the page stylesheet, not from the framework. The colour tokens and the focus ring do ship — see Colors collection and Controls visible.

## Copy to clipboard

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/clipboard.html

Copy to clipboard Stable Одна строка на современном API, с запасным путём через textarea для старых браузеров и file://. Usage <p id="copy-source">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet</p> <button class="btn" type="button" onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText( document.getElementById('copy-source').textContent)"> Copy </button> Live demo Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing Copy navigator.clipboard доступен только в защищённом контексте (https или localhost). Notes На file:// и в старых браузерах navigator.clipboard нет — фолбэк через document.execCommand("copy"). Подтверждение словом, а не всплывашкой: «Copied!» рядом с кнопкой читается мгновенно. Скопированный текст нельзя проверить — не обещайте пользователю больше, чем скопировали.

## Sliding color palette

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/color-palette.html

Sliding color palette Stable Выезжающая панель с образцами цвета: клик по квадрату красит подложку, кнопка прячет и показывает панель. Usage <div class="palette" id="palette"> <div class="swatch" style="background:red" onclick="setColor('red')"></div> <div class="swatch" style="background:blue" onclick="setColor('blue')"></div> <div class="swatch" style="background:green" onclick="setColor('green')"></div> <div class="swatch" style="background:#fffff8" onclick="setColor('transparent')"></div> <button id="btn" onclick="toggle()">&#128193;</button> </div> <style> .palette { position: absolute; left: -300px; transition: left 1.4s; } .palette-open { left: 0; } </style> const palette = document.getElementById('palette'); const setColor = (color) => { document.body.style.background = color; }; const toggle = () => { const open = palette.classList.toggle('palette-open'); document.getElementById('btn').innerHTML = open ? '&#127912;&#128194;' : '&#128193;'; }; /* В исходнике было: cnt.style.left == 0 + 'px' — сравнение пустой строки с '0px', пока left не задан инлайном. */ Live demo .demo-palette-stage { position: relative; height: 140px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; transition: background .5s; } .demo-palette { position: absolute; top: 20px; left: -290px; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 350px; height: 100px; transition: left 1.4s; } .demo-palette-open { left: 0; } .demo-palette-swatch { width: 50px; height: 50px; margin-left: 20px; cursor: pointer; border: .5px solid #000; border-radius: 20px 30px 40px 25px / 20px 30px 40px 25px; } .demo-palette-btn { font-size: 30px; margin-left: 20px; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; background: transparent; outline: none; } 📁 Нажмите кнопку с папкой — панель выедет. Клик по квадрату красит подложку. Notes В исходнике проверка cnt.style.left == 0 + 'px' ломалась: сначала 0 + 'px' → '0px', но style.left пуст, пока не задан inline — первый клик вёл себя непредсказуемо. Заменено на classList.toggle. Фон красится не в body, а в локальную подложку — демо не должно перекрашивать всю страницу документации. Квадраты получили role="button" и tabindex — div без них с клавиатуры недоступен.

## Colors collection

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/colors-collection.html

Colors collection Stable Eight tokens in :root — the brand colour, a text/ground pair, three feedback states and a hairline. Components use them as their base palette; a few surface/control shades are still literals. Recolouring starts with one block, but a complete dark theme needs those literals replaced too. The tokens TokenDefaultRole --accent#8512d1primary action, brand mark, focus ring --ink#222222text --paper#ffffffground --ok / --warn / --errgreen / amber / redfeedback states --line#cececehairlines and borders Overriding them Custom properties inherit — override on :root for the whole page or on any subtree for one section. Most components follow; a few state/surface shades are still literal values and will need a follow-up override. :root { --accent: #e3e027; /* the documentation site’s yellow */ --ink: #000; --paper: #fff; } alert-info follows --accent, not a literal. alert-ok follows --ok. Primary button One override on the wrapper retunes everything inside it. Contrast is the contract Contrast is the contract Body text must reach 4.5:1 against its background, large text 3:1. On the yellow above, black passes and white fails — which is why the label is dark. The tokens give you names; the contrast you check yourself.

## Columns

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/columns.html

Columns Stable pt-1 through pt-12, repeated for every breakpoint prefix. A column is just a width — nothing else is set on it. Class list Unprefixed classes always apply. Prefixed ones apply only inside their own media query, and they override the unprefixed width because the selector is equally specific but declared later. <div class="container-block pt-8 pt-m6 pt-xs12">wide, medium, stacked</div> pt-8 pt-m6 pt-xs12 Resize the window to watch the three widths trade places. Scope The rules are .container .pt-3. A pt-3 element outside a container, or the container itself, gets no width at all — that is the single most common reason a row refuses to line up. Width only Columns carry no padding of their own. The gutter comes from .container-block or from your own class, see Gutters. Per-column alignment alignSelf-center, alignSelf-start, alignSelf-baseline and alignSelf-end override the stretched height for one column. <div class="container align-center"> <div class="container-block pt-4">stretched</div> <div class="container-block pt-4 alignSelf-end">pinned to the end</div> </div> pt-4 alignSelf-end

## Components

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/components.html

Components Stable How components are meant to work in GALS, and what the current build ships. Short answer: grid, helpers, forms and a component set that leans on native browser features. The approach A component in GALS is a class in gals.css that leans on a native browser feature wherever one exists — details, popover, dialog, :checked — so there is no JavaScript API, no registration and no instantiation. The only two behaviours the runtime adds are opt-in: accordion groups and scrollspy. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-4"> <article class="card">…</article> </div> </div> What the current build ships LayerStatus Grid, columns, breakpointsStable Flex and alignment helpersStable Colour tokens and focus ringStable FormsStable Components (14)Stable Accordion groups, scrollspyStable ChartsOut of scope Rules the build follows Every component must work without JavaScript when the browser can express it (details, popover, :checked, <dialog>), must not add a build step, and must not rename anything that already exists.

## Containers

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/containers.html

Containers Stable A container is the flex wrapper that makes column widths meaningful. Everything else in the grid is a child of it. .container Sets display: flex, flex-wrap: wrap, align-items: stretch, gap: 0 and padding: 5px. Column classes only apply inside it, because they are declared as .container .pt-3, not .pt-3. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-12">full width</div> </div> pt-12 One column across the row. .container-fluid Adds flex-grow: 1, so the element eats whatever space its neighbours leave. It is how the documentation page keeps its centre column wide while the side columns stay fixed. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-2">rail</div> <div class="container-block container-fluid">fills the rest</div> <div class="container-block pt-2">rail</div> </div> pt-2 container-fluid pt-2 The middle cell has no width class, only flex-grow. Nesting Containers nest freely — put a .container inside a column to split it again. Keep the wrapper chain intact: a column whose nearest flex ancestor is missing has no effect, since the width rules are descendants of .container. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-8"> <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-6">nested half</div> <div class="container-block pt-6">nested half</div> </div> </div> <div class="container-block pt-4">side</div> </div> pt-6 pt-6 pt-4

## Contents

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/contents.html

Contents Everything the toolkit ships with, grouped the same way as the navigation on the left. Layout The grid is a twelve column flex container. Each column takes calc(var(--gridmultiplyConst) * n), and every prefix maps to one breakpoint: xl 1440px and up, l up to 1439.98px, m 1025px, s 770px, xs 425px, xxs 375px. Breakpoints and grid Breakpoints Containers Grid Columns Gutters Z-index Content Headings, tables and media Header Table Images Charts Icons Forms Controls Form controls Select Checkbox & Radio Range Components Interactive pieces Accordion Alert Buttons Card Carousel Dropdowns Modal Menu Tabs Pagination Popovers Progress Scrollspy Loaders Helpers Utilities Colors collection Classes Controls Audio Controls Video Controls visible Canvas for your projects

## Controls Audio

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/controls-audio.html

Controls Audio Stable An audio player: the native element is the player, the framework makes it behave like a column — full width, no overflow. Usage .audio is display: block; width: 100% — that is the whole class. The browser’s player controls stay native. <audio class="audio" controls preload="metadata" src="track.mp3"> <a href="track.mp3">Download the track</a> </audio> Download the track The chrome of your browser, not a screenshot: native controls, column width. Notes Never autoplay. Autoplay with sound is blocked outright in Chrome and Firefox, so design for a click. Put a transcript or show notes next to the player, not behind a toggle. A link to the file is the fallback that makes the player optional.

## Controls Video

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/controls-video.html

Controls Video Stable Responsive video with captions and a poster: .media holds a 16/9 box, the rest is native elements. Usage .media gives the video an intrinsic aspect-ratio (16/9), so the box is right before any pixel loads — the job the old padding-hack trick used to do, in one line. .media-4-3 and .media-1-1 switch the ratio. <video class="media" controls preload="none" poster="cover.jpg"> <source src="clip.webm" type="video/webm"> <source src="clip.mp4" type="video/mp4"> <track kind="captions" src="clip.en.vtt" srclang="en" label="English" default> <a href="clip.mp4">Download the clip</a> </video> Download the clip .media on a video and on an image — the box is the class, not the element. Notes preload="none" plus a poster: a video that downloads on page load is the most expensive byte on most pages. Captions are a <track>, not burned-in text you cannot translate or turn off. An embed from a hosting service is a tracker with a player attached.

## Controls visible

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/controls-visible.html

Controls visible Stable Whether the thing a user is operating can actually be seen and reached. The framework now ships the focus ring; the rest are the rules your project must keep. Focus The framework sets one global rule: :focus-visible shows the accent ring for keyboard users and hides it for mouse clicks. That removes the only reason designers used to strip outlines. /* gals.css — ships with the framework */ :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } /* never */ *:focus { outline: none; } Tab to me and to me Both take the ring on keyboard focus and drop it on click. Targets and scroll RuleNumber Minimum target size (WCAG 2.2)24×24 CSS px Comfortable on touch44×44 CSS px scroll-padding-topheight of the sticky header Contrast, body text4.5:1 Motion @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } } The framework ships two animations — the spinner and the skeleton shimmer — and opts the shimmer out itself. The spinner keeps running under reduce, because it is information; add the block above in your own layer for everything else.

## CSS variables

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/css-variables.html

CSS variables Stable The framework exposes eight custom properties: the one grid constant and seven colour tokens. Everything else is written as a literal value, so there is nothing to configure at build time. The tokens PropertyDefaultUsed by --gridmultiplyConst8.325%every .container .pt-* width --accent#8512d1brand, primary button, focus ring --ink / --paper#222 / #ffftext and ground pair --ok / --warn / --errgreen / amber / redalerts, validation --line#cececehairlines and borders Overriding them Custom properties inherit, and the column reads the value from itself — so setting it on a container retunes only the columns and components inside that container. .container-dense { --gridmultiplyConst: 8.3333%; } /* exact 1/12 */ .container-half { --gridmultiplyConst: 12.5%; } /* 8 column grid */ /* recolour the whole page */ :root { --accent: #e3e027; --ink: #000; } pt-4 = 1/2 pt-4 = 1/2 The same pt-4 class, a different constant: 12.5% instead of 33.3%. Not part of the framework The documentation site has its own tokens for typography, declared on main and re-declared in the media queries — --fs-h1, --lh-body, --fs-btn and friends. They live in style.css, are not shipped in gals/gals.css, and are safe to ignore when you drop the framework into a project. Why so few variables A toolkit this small is meant to be read, edited and deleted. Variables that hide a single literal make the stylesheet harder to grep, not easier to theme.

## Dismissible alert

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/dismissible-alert.html

Dismissible alert Stable Alert из gals.css плюс кнопка закрытия. Никакого Bootstrap — те же токены, те же классы. Usage <div class="alert alert-info" id="save-alert" role="status"> <span>Please click on the Basket button for result.</span> <button class="btn" type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('save-alert').remove()" aria-label="Dismiss">&times;</button> </div> Live demo Please click on the Basket button for result. × Кнопка закрытия — обычный .btn; логика удаления — одна строка JS. Notes role="status" вежлив для скринридера. Для важного — role="alert". Кнопка закрытия несёт aria-label: значок «×» без подписи читается как «times». Если алерт можно закрыть, он не должен быть единственным носителем важного.

## Distance calculator

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/distance-calculator.html

Distance calculator Stable Расстояние между двумя точками: ввод координат, формула, расчёт и рисунок на canvas. Usage D = √((x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²) const d = Math.sqrt((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2); Live demo .dc-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:10px 20px; align-items:center; max-width:640px; } .dc-grid input { width: 60px; padding: 4px 6px; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; font: 13px system-ui; } .dc-out { font: 14px system-ui; color: #8512d1; font-weight: 600; } .dc-canvas { border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%; } x₁ = x₂ = y₁ = y₂ = Calculate D = ? Введите координаты и нажмите Calculate: увидите отрезок AB и расстояние. Notes Раньше длина проверялась у числа через x1.length === "" — это всегда false. Заменено на нормальный разбор Number() и || 0. MathJax и jQuery из исходника убраны — формула читается в обычном HTML (<sub>, <sup>). Масштаб и центр подобраны под канвас 600×300, для другого размера — пересчитайте scale.

## Download GALS

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/download.html

Download GALS Download grid.zip GALS ships as two framework files and nothing else. No build step, no dependencies, no configuration. Integrity: SHA-256 checksum for the archive. License: MIT. Get the source Grab the latest archive, or take the framework files straight from the gals/ folder of the repository. gals/ gals.css /* the grid and helpers */ gals.js /* menu, dropdowns, accordion groups, scrollspy, fluid images */ What's inside The archive contains the two framework files plus a README and the MIT license: the grid stylesheet with responsive columns and component styles, and the runtime script for the mobile menu, accordion groups, scrollspy and fluid images. Use it Drop the stylesheet into the <head> and the script right before the closing </body> tag. Everything else is plain HTML. Alternatively, load GALS from the jsDelivr CDN — no download needed: <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IvanIvanson/gals@v1.2/gals-main/cdn/gals.min.css"> <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IvanIvanson/gals@v1.2/gals-main/cdn/gals.min.js"></script> See jsDelivr CDN on the Introduction page for production tips. <style>*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}</style> <link rel="stylesheet" href="./gals/gals.css"> <script src="./gals/gals.js" defer></script>

## Dropdowns

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/dropdowns.html

Dropdowns Stable A command menu on a button. Not a form control — that job is a select. Usage <button popovertarget="dd">Options</button> <div id="dd" popover class="dropdown"> <button type="button">Rename</button> <button type="button">Duplicate</button> <button type="button">Delete</button> </div> Live demo Options Rename Duplicate Delete The Popover API gives top layer, light dismiss and Escape; gals.js adds anchoring and arrow-key navigation. Notes The trigger keeps aria-haspopup="menu" and a live aria-expanded when gals.js is loaded. Arrow keys move through items; Tab leaves the menu. Closing returns focus to the trigger — the browser does this for popover, hand-rolled menus usually do not.

## Form controls

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/form-controls.html

Form controls Stable Text inputs, textareas and the wrapper that stacks a label, a control and a hint. The grid gives a field its column; the framework gives the field its box. Field .field stacks label, control and hint with a small gap; .field-hint is small muted text wired with aria-describedby. Put the field in a column and the grid handles the width. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-6 pt-xs12"> <div class="field"> <label for="name">Name</label> <input class="input" id="name" name="name" autocomplete="name"> </div> </div> <div class="container-block pt-6 pt-xs12"> <div class="field"> <label for="email">Email</label> <input class="input" id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" aria-describedby="email-hint"> <p class="field-hint" id="email-hint">We only use this for the receipt.</p> </div> </div> </div> Name Email We only use this for the receipt. The widths are the grid classes; the box, the focus ring and the hint are the framework. States Three states ship: the focus ring on :focus-visible, [disabled], and [aria-invalid="true"] for validation. Set aria-invalid from your validation script — colour alone is not a state. City Postal code A postal code is five digits. Managed Tab through: the ring appears on keyboard focus and stays off for clicks. Widths .input-1 through .input-12 size a control from the same 1/12 scale as the columns, so a field can sit in a row without a column wrapper. They apply anywhere; the column classes still apply only inside a .container. ClassApplies toEffect .inputinput, textareathe base box, font, padding and focus ring .input-6any controlwidth from the same 1/12 scale .fieldwrapperstacks label, control and hint .field-hintpsmall text wired with aria-describedby .field-groupfieldsetborderless reset, keeps legend as the name

## Gradient text

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/gradient-text.html

Gradient text Stable Текст, залитый градиентом: background-clip: text и прозрачная заливка. Только CSS. Usage <h2 class="gradient-text">Lorem ipsum</h2> <style> .gradient-text { font-size: 3em; font-weight: 800; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(120deg, yellow, #ec0707); -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; } </style> Live demo .demo-gradient-text { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 3em; font-weight: 800; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #b57d0a, #ec0707); -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; margin: .5em 0; } Lorem ipsum Notes Чистый yellow на белом не читается — в демо жёлтый затемнён до охры. Проверяйте контраст. Пара -webkit-text-fill-color + background-clip: text нужна обоим движкам: и Chromium, и Firefox. Без background-clip: text градиент зальёт весь прямоугольник, а не буквы.

## Grid

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/grid.html

Grid Stable Twelve columns of 8.325% each, built from one custom property and a set of flex helpers. No CSS grid, no subpixel math, no build step. The model Every column resolves to calc(var(--gridmultiplyConst) * n), where the constant is 8.325%. Twelve of them make 99.9% — the spare tenth of a percent is what keeps a full row from wrapping when the browser rounds. :root { --gridmultiplyConst: 8.325%; } .container .pt-4 { width: calc(var(--gridmultiplyConst) * 4); } Rows There is no row element. flex-wrap: wrap on the container starts a new line as soon as the widths exceed the container, so a row is whatever fits before the wrap. <div class="container"> <div class="container-block pt-4">4</div> <div class="container-block pt-4">4</div> <div class="container-block pt-4">4</div> <div class="container-block pt-6">6 — wraps to the next line</div> <div class="container-block pt-6">6</div> </div> pt-4 pt-4 pt-4 pt-6 pt-6 Aligning a row Three helpers set justify-content on the container, three more set align-items. They are plain classes, not breakpoint-scoped. <div class="container space-center"> <div class="container-block pt-3">3</div> <div class="container-block pt-3">3</div> </div> pt-3 pt-3 space-center — space-between and space-around are the other two.

## Configurable grid canvas

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/grid-canvas.html

Configurable grid canvas Stable Сетка на <canvas>: размер ячейки ползунком, вертикальные линии — чекбоксом. Чёткие линии через сдвиг на 0.5px. Usage <canvas id="canvas" width="300" height="300"></canvas> <input type="range" id="cellSize" min="10" max="100" value="30" step="5"> <input type="checkbox" id="showVertical" checked> const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); function drawGrid() { const cell = parseInt(document.getElementById('cellSize').value, 10); const vertical = document.getElementById('showVertical').checked; const W = canvas.width; const H = canvas.height; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(0.5, 0.5); // crisp 1px lines const stroke = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke(); }; for (let i = 0; i <= Math.floor(H / cell); i++) { ctx.lineWidth = i === 5 ? 3 : 1; ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? 'red' : 'green'; stroke(0, i * cell, W, i * cell); } if (vertical) { for (let i = 0; i <= Math.floor(W / cell); i++) { ctx.lineWidth = i === 5 ? 3 : 1; ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? 'red' : 'green'; stroke(i * cell, 0, i * cell, H); } } ctx.restore(); } document.getElementById('cellSize').addEventListener('input', drawGrid); document.getElementById('showVertical').addEventListener('change', drawGrid); drawGrid(); Live demo .demo-grid-controls { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px; font: 14px system-ui; } .demo-grid-controls label { display: inline-block; margin: 0 10px; } .demo-grid-canvas { display: block; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #333; image-rendering: pixelated; } Cell size: 30px Vertical lines Redraw Двигайте ползунок — сетка перестраивается. Пятая линия выделена толщиной. Notes Сдвиг translate(0.5, 0.5) совмещает координаты с центрами физических пикселей — линии в 1px не размываются. В исходнике сдвиг откатывался вторым translate(-0.5, -0.5) — надёжнее пара save()/restore(). parseInt(value, 10) с явной системой счисления — значение из range всегда строка.

## Gutters

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/gutters.html

Gutters Stable Gutters are padding, not gap. The grid ships with 5px on the container and 5px on each block, which is why the whole thing depends on border-box. Where the space comes from SelectorRuleEffect .containerpadding: 5pxOuter inset of the row .containergap: 0Flex gap stays off on purpose .container .container-blockpadding: 5pxSpace between neighbouring columns Because gap is zero, two neighbouring blocks produce 5px + 5px between their contents. border-box is required Column widths are percentages. If the box model is content-box, the 5px of padding is added on top of the percentage, the row exceeds 100% and wraps early. GALS does not set box-sizing for you, so reset it in your project: *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } Load order The reset must come after gals.css only if you want to override its values. For box-sizing the order does not matter, since gals.css never touches it. Widening the gutter .container-wide, .container-wide .container-block { padding: 12px; } pt-12 pt-12 Inline styles here stand in for the override class.

## Animated hamburger

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/hamburger.html

Animated hamburger Stable SVG-гамбургер, превращающийся в крестик. Только SVG и <animate> — ни строчки JavaScript. Usage <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" class="hamburger-demo"> <path fill="none" stroke="#8512d1" stroke-width="10" d="M 20 20 C 24 20 36 20 50 20 C 64 20 76 20 80 20"> <animate attributeName="d" values="M 20 20 C 24 20 36 20 50 20 C 64 20 76 20 80 20; M 20 20 C 37 37 37 37 50 50 C 63 37 63 37 80 20" dur=".5s" begin="menuBtn.click" fill="freeze"/> <animate attributeName="d" values="M 20 20 C 37 37 37 37 50 50 C 63 37 63 37 80 20; M 20 20 C 24 20 36 20 50 20 C 64 20 76 20 80 20" dur=".5s" begin="backToMenu.click" fill="freeze"/> </path> <path id="backToMenu" d="M 0 0 h0v0h0z" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0)"/> <path id="menuBtn" d="M 0 0 h100v100h-100z" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0)"/> </svg> Live demo Кликните по квадрату: две прозрачные области переключают фазу анимации. Notes Анимация декларативна: begin="menuBtn.click" привязывает её к клику по невидимой фигуре. SVG лучше пометить aria-hidden="true" — это декорация. Для реального меню рядом ставится <button> с aria-expanded.

## Header

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/header.html

Header Stable A page bar: brand, navigation and actions in one flex row that wraps on small screens instead of overflowing. Usage .header is a flex row with a wrap and a gap. .header-sticky pins it to the top of the viewport, and the three slots are optional: .header-brand, .header-nav and .header-actions, which pushes to the right edge with margin-left: auto. <header class="header header-sticky"> <a class="header-brand" href="/">GALS</a> <nav class="header-nav" aria-label="Main"> <ul> <li><a href="/docs" aria-current="page">Docs</a></li> <li><a href="/support">Support</a></li> </ul> </nav> <div class="header-actions"> <a class="btn" href="/download">Download</a> </div> </header> GALS Docs Support Download Narrow the window: the row wraps instead of overflowing. Accessibility Mark the current page with aria-current="page" — the framework turns it into the bold link, so the state is not colour-only. Two headers on one page need distinct aria-labels on their <nav>, or the landmark list is useless. Sticky is opt-in The bar at the top of this documentation page is the site’s own stylesheet, not the framework. .header-sticky exists so your header does not have to repeat it.

## History

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/history.html

History Partial How a course landing page turned into a grid file, and why the framework stayed this small. Timeline Begins as a single landing page with a hand-written flex row. The row becomes .container and twelve pt-* classes. Six breakpoints are added by copying the block six times — the reason the prefixes are independent rather than mobile-first. The mobile menu and fluid images move into gals.js, no dependencies. Colour tokens, focus, forms and fourteen components land in one release — every one of them leaning on a native browser feature instead of a script. The documentation site grows around it, and the status badges stop saying “planned”. Decisions that still hold DecisionConsequence Percent widths from one constantwith border-box a full row is 99.9%, so rounding never wraps it Gutters as padding, gap: 0requires border-box, see Gutters No build step in the shipped filesthe framework is readable and editable in place Nothing exported from gals.jsthe file is meant to be copied, not imported Compatibility rules Class names are public API: renaming one is a breaking change. Markup patterns may gain attributes ' — every hook is additive — but never lose one that already works. Versioning The header lists the public releases v1.2 and v1.1. The package version is 1.2.0; the older “ultra-light / light / optimus” labels are retired.

## Icons

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/icons.html

Icons Stable Size classes for inline SVG. The icon inherits colour from the text around it — fill: currentColor is the whole trick, and there is no icon font to load. Usage .icon sets fill: currentColor; .icon-16, .icon-24 and .icon-32 set the box. The SVG stays inline in the markup or points at a sprite with <use> — both work the same. <svg class="icon icon-16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"> <use href="/icons.svg#clipboard"></use> </svg> <button class="btn" type="button"> <svg class="icon icon-16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">…</svg> Copy </button> 16px 24px 32px The same three on a coloured line — no colour is set anywhere: the icon follows the text. currentColor: the star took no colour of its own. Decorative icons Decorative icons Keep aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false" on the SVG, and put the accessible name on the button around it. An icon that carries meaning needs a text equivalent next to it, not inside the alt of nothing.

## Images

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/images.html

Images Stable One real behaviour: an image marked container-fluid is measured against its parent by gals.js and resized in pixels, on load and on every settled resize. Usage The script looks for img.container-fluid, reads the parent block and writes the result into the inline style. The parent needs a size of its own — a column class is enough. <div class="container"> <figure class="container-block pt-6"> <img class="container-fluid" src="cover.svg" alt="Cover art"> </figure> </div> What is measured Parent clientWidth minus its computed horizontal padding. The result lands in style.width; style.height stays auto so the image keeps its aspect ratio. Inline style is deliberate: attributes would be overridden by the stylesheet and did nothing. Runs onWhen DOMContentLoadedfirst paint, or immediately if the DOM is already parsed resize150ms after the last resize event gals:refreshafter SPA-style content replacement Caveats A parent with zero width is skipped rather than collapsing the image to nothing, so an image inside a hidden tab keeps its natural size until it becomes visible. After injecting markup without a resize, dispatch gals:refresh (the documentation renderer does this for you). pt-6 The image above is fitted to its column by the shipped script.

## Interactive canvas chart

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/interactive-canvas.html

Interactive canvas chart Stable Пользователь сам вводит координаты точки и легенду — canvas перерисовывает график. Usage <input id="ic-x" size="2"> X <input id="ic-y" size="2"> Y <input id="ic-legend" size="10"> Legend <button class="btn" id="ic-add">Add</button> <canvas id="ic-canvas" width="600" height="400"></canvas> Live demo .ic-wrap { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; max-width:340px; } .ic-inputs { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; font: 13px system-ui; } .ic-inputs input { width: 60px; padding: 4px 6px; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; font: inherit; } .ic-inputs input#ic-legend { width: 100px; } .ic-canvas { border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; max-width:100%; } X Y Legend Add point Reset Введите X и Y, нажмите Add point — точка добавится и линия перерисуется. Notes Canvas перерисовывается целиком на каждое добавление — так проще, чем инкрементально. Для десятков точек это работает мгновенно; для тысяч — нужен Path2D и слои. Координаты можно тащить мышью: добавляется обработчик pointerdown/move/up, canvas остаётся тем же.

## JS modules

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/js-modules.html

JS modules Stable gals.js is one immediately invoked function of about 330 lines. It has no exports, no dependencies and nothing to import — it finds its own hooks in the DOM. What is inside PieceTriggerWhat it does initMenu()click on .icon-menutoggles .menu-show on .menu and syncs aria-expanded initDropdowns()[popovertarget] + .dropdownpositions the popover at the trigger, sets aria-haspopup/aria-expanded and handles arrows/Home/End fitFluidImages()ready, resize, gals:refreshsets width by the parent content box and height:auto on img.container-fluid initAccordions()toggle on detailsinside .accordion-group, opening one accordion closes the others initScrollspy()scrollinside [data-scrollspy], marks the link to the heading in view with aria-current debounce()internalcollapses resize events to one call per 150ms Menu Both elements must exist or the feature stays off — the script returns early rather than throwing, so pages without a mobile menu are unaffected. <div class="menu menu-collapse" id="main-menu">…</div> <button class="icon-menu" type="button" aria-label="Toggle menu" aria-controls="main-menu" aria-expanded="false">≡</button> Accordion groups and scrollspy Both new features are opt-in: wrap accordions in .accordion-group to make siblings close on open, and put data-scrollspy on any nav whose links point at headings — this page’s “On this page” block does exactly that. <div class="accordion-group">…</div> <div class="inthisPage" data-scrollspy>…</div> Fluid images For every img.container-fluid, the script measures the parent block, subtracts its horizontal padding and writes width plus height: auto into the inline style. Inline style is deliberate: attributes would be overridden by the stylesheet and did nothing. Dispatch gals:refresh after replacing markup without a page reload. <figure class="container-block"> <img class="container-fluid" src="cover.svg" alt=""> </figure> Reusing the code Nothing is exported on purpose — the file is meant to be read and copied. If you need the debounced resize on your own feature, take the three helpers rather than importing the bundle, and register the listener with addEventListener so you do not stomp on the framework's own handler. const debounce = (fn, wait) => { let timer; return (...args) => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), wait); }; }; window.addEventListener('resize', debounce(recalculate, 150));

} .demo-ripple span:nth-child(12) { inset: 110px; animation-delay: .2s; } Wireframe cube (canvas) A rotating 3D cube projected onto 2D canvas — for dashboards that want a heavier, sci-fi loading state. <canvas id="cube" width="400" height="400"></canvas> <script> const ctx = document.getElementById('cube').getContext('2d'); const vertices = [ {x:-1,y:-1,z:-1}, {x:1,y:-1,z:-1}, {x:1,y:1,z:-1}, {x:-1,y:1,z:-1}, {x:-1,y:-1,z:1}, {x:1,y:-1,z:1}, {x:1,y:1,z:1}, {x:-1,y:1,z:1}, ]; const edges = [ [0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,0], [4,5],[5,6],[6,7],[7,4], [0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7], ]; let angleX = 0, angleY = 0, angleZ = 0; function project(p) { const fov = 300; const scale = fov / (fov + p.z); return { x: p.x * scale * 50 + 200, y: p.y * scale * 50 + 200 }; } function rotate(p) { let { x, y, z } = p; [y, z] = [y * Math.cos(angleX) - z * Math.sin(angleX), y * Math.sin(angleX) + z * Math.cos(angleX)]; [x, z] = [x * Math.cos(angleY) + z * Math.sin(angleY), -x * Math.sin(angleY) + z * Math.cos(angleY)]; [x, y] = [x * Math.cos(angleZ) - y * Math.sin(angleZ), x * Math.sin(angleZ) + y * Math.cos(angleZ)]; return { x, y, z }; } function draw() { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 400); angleX += .02; angleY += .03; angleZ += .01; edges.forEach(([a, b]) => { const p1 = project(rotate(vertices[a])); const p2 = project(rotate(vertices[b])); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y); ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y); ctx.stroke(); }); requestAnimationFrame(draw); } draw(); </script> Run animation

## Menu

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/menu.html

Menu Stable Site navigation: a list of links in a nav, plus the mobile panel the bundled script toggles. Usage <nav class="menu menu-collapse" id="main-menu" aria-label="Main"> <ul> <li><a href="/docs" aria-current="page">Docs</a></li> <li><a href="/support">Support</a></li> </ul> </nav> <button class="icon-menu" type="button" aria-label="Toggle menu" aria-controls="main-menu" aria-expanded="false">&#8801;</button> Live demo Docs Support About aria-current="page" becomes the bold link; the mobile toggle is gals.js. Notes Mark the current page with aria-current="page", not only with a colour. The header of this very site is the framework menu plus the site’s own paint. Two navs on one page need distinct aria-labels or the landmark list is useless.

## Modal

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/modal.html

Modal Stable A dialog that takes focus, holds it, and gives it back. Usage <button onclick="demoModal.showModal()">Open</button> <dialog id="demoModal" class="modal"> <form method="dialog"> <h2>Delete the draft?</h2> <p>This cannot be undone.</p> <div class="card-footer"> <button value="cancel">Cancel</button> <button value="confirm" class="btn btn-primary">Delete</button> </div> </form> </dialog> Live demo Delete a draft Delete the draft? This cannot be undone. Cancel Delete showModal() gives the trap, the inert page, Escape and ::backdrop for free. Notes A modal inside an ancestor with a transform is trapped in that stacking context — dialog’s top layer avoids this. Lock scroll with scrollbar-gutter: stable so the page does not jump sideways. Two stacked modals usually mean the flow wants to be a page, not a dialog.

## Modal bounce

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/modal-bounce.html

Modal bounce Stable Модалка с пружинной анимацией появления. Три варианта: stretch-in, stretch-up, stretch-out. Usage <button class="btn" onclick="modal.showModal()">Open</button> <dialog id="modal" class="modal"> <form method="dialog"><button class="btn">Close</button></form> </dialog> @keyframes squish-in { 60% { transform: scale(.5, 1.6); } 80% { transform: scale(.9, 1.3); } 100% { transform: scale(1, 1); } } Live demo @keyframes mb-in { 0% { transform: scale(.3, .3); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: scale(.9, 1.15); opacity: 1; } 80% { transform: scale(1.05, .9); } 100% { transform: scale(1, 1); } } .mb-modal { border: none; border-radius: 14px; padding: 26px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25); animation: mb-in .5s cubic-bezier(.47,1.64,.41,.8) forwards; max-width: 320px; } .mb-modal::backdrop { background: rgba(0,0,0,.4); animation: none; } stretch-in Ready to save? This is a bounce modal. Save Notes Анимация только на <dialog>, backdrop не анимирован — так проще. Форма с method="dialog" закрывает модалку по любой кнопке без JS. Три варианта пружины — это три @keyframes с разной последовательностью scale.

## Morphing buttons (On / Off)

Notes В исходнике оба кнопки независимы — можно «вдавить» обе одновременно. Здесь пара работает как radio: нажатие одной сбрасывает другую. Каждая кнопка имеет aria-pressed для скринридеров. Пару переключает runtime-хелпер toggleMorphPair. Исходный код был частью лендинга-демо; в компоненте выделена только пара кнопок — полный лендинг см. в Features «Morphing style landing». Цвета blue/red на #ececec проходят AA для крупного текста (25px) — мелкий текст таких цветов требует темнее.

## Morphing checked button

Morphing checked button Stable Нейроморфная кнопка-переключатель с индикатором: :has() без JavaScript — состояние «включено» меняет тень и свечение индикатора. Notes В исходнике состояние переключалось через classList на JS-обработчике — здесь чистый CSS :has() (Chrome 105+, Safari 15.4+, Firefox 121+). В более старом Firefox индикатор не светится, но переключение работает. role="switch" сообщает скринридеру, что это переключатель, а не чекбокс с двойным кликом. Фокус-кольцо :focus-visible обязательно — инпут скрыт через opacity: 0, без него клавиатурная навигация «слепая». Индикатор для Off по умолчанию красный — это стилистический приём, но с точки зрения доступности красный ассоциируется с ошибкой. Для продакшена используйте серый по умолчанию.

## Morphing range

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/morphing-range.html

Morphing range Stable Нейроморфный ползунок: «утопленный» жёлоб и «выпуклый» брусок на одних box-shadow. Значение выводится в <output>. Notes В исходнике ползунок имел высоту жёлоба 0.5px — при appearance:none он практически невидим и неинтерактивен в Firefox. Исправлено до 8px. Firefox не поддерживает ::-webkit-slider-thumb — добавлен ::-moz-range-thumb. Метка label for="..." обязательна: без неё ползунок недоступен с клавиатуры и скринридера. Метки из <option label> рисует только Chromium; в Firefox/WebKit ползунок гладкий. В оригинале первый слайдер обновлялся по onchange (только при отпускании) — заменено на oninput для мгновенной обратной связи. innerHTML заменён на textContent: значение — число, HTML-тегов нет.

Notes В исходном коде был :root — переменные --accent и другие перекрывали токены страницы документации. Переменные перенесены на обёртку .demo-nl. В исходном коде были селекторы html, body { margin:0 } и * { box-sizing } — внутри страницы документации это ломает вёрстку сайта. Все селекторы скоуплены. Класс .btn в исходнике совпадал с GALS .btn и переопределял его — переименован в .demo-nl-btn. Аналогично .feature, .icon, .nav, .demo. Переключатели управлялись JS (classList.toggle). Заменено на чистый CSS :has(input:checked) — браузерные чекбоксы дают фокус, клавиатуру и скринридер бесплатно. Добавлены role="switch", aria-label и :focus-visible — скрытый через opacity:0 инпут без кольца фокуса делает навигацию вслепую невозможной. Кнопки CTA (<a>) используют :active для вдавливания вместо JS setTimeout — :active работает мгновенно и не требует обработчика. В исходном коде id="demo" совпадал с id секции «Live demo» страницы документации — заменён на nl-demo.

## Pagination

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/pagination.html

Pagination Stable Numbered links for a list that spans requests. Usage <nav class="pagination" aria-label="Results"> <a href="?p=4" aria-label="Previous">&#8249;</a> <a href="?p=4">4</a> <span aria-current="page">5</span> <a href="?p=6">6</a> <span aria-hidden="true">&#8230;</span> <a href="?p=20">20</a> </nav> Live demo ‹ 4 5 6 7 … 20 Notes Ellipses are aria-hidden; the current page carries aria-current="page". Infinite scroll destroys the footer and the sense of position. Use it where scrolling is the activity, not where results are. Icon pill pagination Пилюля с круглыми кнопочками-иконками: активная страница подсвечивается кольцом. Стрелки листают, иконки выбирают страницу напрямую. <nav class="icon-pagination" aria-label="Results"> <ul> <li><button class="pgi-nav" type="button" data-step="-1" onclick="shiftPagination(this, -1)">&#8249; Prev</button></li> <li><button class="pgi-num is-active" type="button" aria-current="page" aria-label="Home" onclick="selectPagination(this)"> <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"> <path d="M3 11.5 12 4l9 7.5V21h-6v-6h-6v6H3z"/> </svg> </button></li> <!-- …ещё страницы --> <li><button class="pgi-nav" type="button" data-step="1" onclick="shiftPagination(this, 1)">Next &#8250;</button></li> </ul> <p class="pgi-status" role="status">Page 1 of 5</p> </nav> <style> .icon-pagination ul { display: flex; align-items: center; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 10px 20px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50px; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.2); } .icon-pagination li { margin: 0 5px; } .icon-pagination li:first-child { margin-right: 30px; } .icon-pagination li:last-child { margin-left: 30px; } .pgi-nav { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; color: #4a4a4a; } .pgi-nav[disabled] { opacity: .35; cursor: default; } .pgi-num { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 50px; height: 50px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: #4a4a4a; cursor: pointer; transition: .3s; } .pgi-num:hover, .pgi-num.is-active { background: #86ff3d; color: #123a05; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, 0 0 0 6px #86ff3d; } </style> .demo-pgi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: #cdecb0; padding: 28px 16px; border-radius: 7px; } .demo-pgi-list { display: flex; align-items: center; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 10px 20px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50px; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.2); } .demo-pgi-list li { margin: 0 5px; } .demo-pgi-list li:first-child { margin-right: 30px; } .demo-pgi-list li:last-child { margin-left: 30px; } .demo-pgi-nav { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; color: #4a4a4a; } .demo-pgi-nav[disabled] { opacity: .35; cursor: default; } .demo-pgi-num { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 50px; height: 50px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: #4a4a4a; cursor: pointer; transition: .3s; } .demo-pgi-num:hover, .demo-pgi-num.is-active { background: #86ff3d; color: #123a05; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, 0 0 0 6px #86ff3d; } .demo-pgi-nav:focus-visible, .demo-pgi-num:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2f7d1a; outline-offset: 2px; } .demo-pgi-status { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #2c4a17; } ‹ Prev Next › Page 1 of 5 Стрелки листают по краям и отключаются, иконки выбирают страницу. Скринридер читает «Page N of 5». В исходном jQuery .find('.pageNumber.active') вызывался после .addClass('active') — выбирались обе страницы, а на краю списка класс active попадал на стрелку Next, и пагинация навсегда застревала. Здесь индекс считается числом и зажимается краями. jQuery (35 КБ gzip) убран целиком: переключение класса — это classList.toggle, а не повод тянуть библиотеку. Класс .pagination в исходнике совпадал с GALS-классом и ломал бы обычную пагинацию на той же странице. Демо использует .demo-pgi-*. Глобальные * { margin:0; padding:0 }, body { display:flex } и ul { … } внутри страницы документации обнулили бы отступы и списки всего сайта. Все селекторы скоуплены. Ссылки <a href="#"> заменены на <button type="button">: страница не меняется — это действие, а не переход. Плюс пропало битое href="#"; return false; в разметке. Font Awesome 4.7 (CDN) заменён на инлайновые SVG: нет внешнего запроса, иконки наследуют currentColor и не ломаются, если CDN недоступен. Белый текст на #86ff3d даёт контраст ~1.6:1 — не читается. Активная страница залита тем же салатовым, но текст тёмный #123a05. Иконка без текста непонятна скринридеру: у каждой кнопки aria-label, у текущей — aria-current="page", у счётчика — role="status". -webkit-box-reflect — вендорная фича WebKit, в Firefox и Edge её нет. Убран; при желании верните как чистую decoration-надстройку.

## Parabola drawer

URL: https://ivanivanson.github.io/gals/docs/parabola-drawer.html

Parabola drawer Stable График квадратичной функции y = ax² + bx + c. Ввод коэффициентов — рисуется парабола и считаются корни. Usage const disc = b*b - 4*a*c; if (disc >= 0) { const x1 = (-b + Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2*a); const x2 = (-b - Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2*a); } Live demo .pd-formula { font: 15px/1.6 system-ui; text-align:center; margin-bottom: 12px; color:#333; } .pd-formula input { width: 50px; padding:4px 6px; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; text-align:center; font: inherit; } .pd-canvas { border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%; background:#fff; } .pd-out { text-align:center; font:14px system-ui; color:#d1495b; font-weight:600; margin-top:8px; } y = x² + x + Draw Измените коэффициенты и нажмите Draw. Парабола перерисуется, внизу появятся корни. Notes Раньше в коде была ctx.fillStyle с non-breaking space — современный парсер такое не принимает. Заменено на обычные пробелы. Рисование одним path по 600 точкам работает быстрее, чем 600 отдельных fillRect. При a = 0 функция перестаёт быть квадратичной — об этом честно сообщаем текстом.

## Person cards + modal
